Priority is based on reuse potential and platform leverage, not benchmark importance or execution success.
Bespoke projection means source-specific package mapping exists.
Inventory projection means the world has a valid AIDF package shape but still needs runtime execution wiring.
This rollup proves adapter contract projection/readiness metadata, not benchmark execution.
World-package projections still require heavy runtime execution before claiming benchmark scores.
Bespoke projections are source-specific contract mappers; inventory projections are first-pass package contracts that still need runtime adapters.
unsafe_claims: This rollup approves production or promotion.
